title: The Founder to Investor Journey

reader_summary.headline: The startup founder's journey doesn't ever go neatly, from Eureka Moment to product market fit, to growth, to exit.
reader_summary.overview: The startup founder's journey doesn't ever go neatly, from Eureka Moment to product market fit, to growth, to exit. But while every journey is different, some of the lessons remain the same. This week, we have a special crossover episode from June 2021.

key_points.text: The startup founder's journey doesn't ever go neatly, from Eureka Moment to product market fit, to growth, to exit.
key_points.evidence_quote: The startup founder's journey doesn't ever go neatly, from Eureka Moment to product market fit, to growth, to exit, because there are many twists and turns along the way.

key_points.text: Joel Beasley, host of the Modern CTO podcast, interview's A16Z general partner, David Yulevich.
key_points.evidence_quote: Joel Beasley, host of the Modern CTO podcast, interview's A16Z general partner, David Yulevich, about David's journey from working at an ISP and dot com company MP3.com in high school.

key_points.text: school, to starting, running, and selling his own enterprise security company, OpenDNS, to becoming an investor at A16C.

key_points.text: They also discussed the value of product marketing for enterprise, David's philosophy around pricing enterprise products, how to survive and lead through hard times.
key_points.evidence_quote: They also discussed the value of product marketing for enterprise, David's philosophy around pricing enterprise products, how to survive and lead through hard times, new trends in startup investing, and more.

thesis: The episode features an interview between Joel Beasley and A16C general partner David Yulevich regarding Yulevich's career progression from working at an ISP and MP3.com to founding and selling OpenDNS. The discussion covers topics such as the value of product marketing for enterprise, pricing philosophies, and leadership during difficult times.
